$comment: SSS / PhilHealth / Pag-IBIG contribution parameters. These change on statutory schedules — every block must be reconciled against the current circulars (see confidence flags).

legalBasis: RA 11199 (Social Security Act of 2018) Sec 4 — contribution schedule final step effective 2025
sss.notes: 15% of the monthly salary credit (MSC), employer 10% / employee 5%. MSC ₱5,000–₱35,000; the portion above ₱20,000 goes to the mandatory provident fund (WISP). EC premium is employer-paid. Self-employed members pay the full 15% of their declared MSC. Confirm the current year's circular.

legalBasis: RA 11223 (Universal Health Care Act) Sec 10 — premium schedule final step 5% in 2024-2025
philhealth.notes: 5% of the monthly basic salary, floor ₱10,000 / ceiling ₱100,000, split equally between employer and employee. Self-employed direct contributors pay the full 5% of declared income. Confirm the ceiling/rate for the current year.

legalBasis: HDMF Circular 460 — fund salary ceiling ₱10,000 effective Feb 2024
pagibig.notes: Employees earning ≤₱1,500/month contribute 1%, otherwise 2%; employers always 2%; both computed on a fund salary capped at ₱10,000 (max ₱200 + ₱200). Self-employed members contribute on the same schedule based on declared income, shouldering both shares. Confirm current circular.
